text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Even after training, Ines Fujin stays 
busy. She works part-time jobs at various 
shops to help pay for her younger sisters' 
dance lessons.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Training, academics, part-time work... She 
never cuts corners on anything. Preparing 
for her debut race—the first step toward 
her dream—with everything she's got.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Ines Fujin's co-workers cheer on her 
hardworking attitude. Everyone, myself 
included, is drawn to her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
If she doesn't have enough practice time, 
I just need to support her even more. As 
her Trainer, I'll be there for her every 
step of the way!
